description: Verify that the configured key works and the delivery rail accepts announcements, without interrupting anybody: it queues a line at importance 0, which every client drops under its own floor. Use this once when wiring an agent up, or when announce fails and you need to tell a bad key apart from an unreachable rail. Returns the base URL and whether the credential was accepted.

note.description: Optional label recorded on the probe, to tell two agents apart in a log.

name: check_rail
title: Check the delivery rail
